remarks: Beautifully renovated inside and out. This home features extensive exterior upgrades, including a new irrigation system, masonry steps and walkway, and lush new landscaping with tall trees creating a park-like setting. Step inside to discover a sparkling, brand-new kitchen, elegant full and half baths, and a spacious lower-level family room-perfect for entertaining. Additional highlights include top-of-the-line window treatments, a new heating and central air conditioning system, and a fully updated electrical system. A new laundry area with built-in storage adds convenience, while the expansive, oversized deck offers the privacy and serenity of a two-acre estate. Truly a must-see property that blends modern luxury with natural beauty. Arborvitae plantings on front lawn will be continued to end of fence.
